title: ctenitis cyclochlamys
intro: Ctenitis cyclochlamys, commonly known as the maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis cyclochlamys include wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues, making it a valuable medicinal plant in various cultures. The bioactive constituents of Ctenitis cyclochlamys include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
